# Amope PediMask Kit: 20-Minute Foot Mask for Smooth, Soft Heels

Give your feet the care they work so hard to deserve. The Amopé PediMask Kit delivers a 20-minute foot treatment that softens and rejuvenates heels, leaving skin feeling smooth after a single use.

## Nourishing Ingredients That Hydrate

Each sock mask is enriched with moisturizers and macadamia oil. These ingredients provide long-lasting hydration, so your skin stays comfortable long after treatment.

## Easy, Mess-Free Treatment

Slip on the sock mask and let it stay in place while you relax. After 20 minutes, remove it and massage any remaining product into your feet. Cleanup is quick, so you can fit self-care into a busy day.

## Smoother Heels, Simple Routine

Three masks in every pack make it easy to build a consistent foot care habit. Customers have noticed softer, more comfortable feet, and the results can build with regular use.

## Pair for Best Results

For even smoother feet, use the PediMask with the Amopé Electronic Foot File. Together, they make a practical routine for maintaining soft, healthy-looking feet.

**Treat your feet to a spa-style pedicure at home. Add the Amopé PediMask Kit to your cart today.**
